editorial:
Imagine being locked up in a police station, handcuffed and hated by everyone, only to realize the world outside is ending. That is exactly where you start with this ride. You follow a tough guy who is already having the worst night of his life, but things get way worse when zombies start breaking in. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel the panic of being trapped in a small space with monsters while the people supposed to protect you are just as scared as you are.

What really works here is the action and the way the tension builds up. The acting feels real, and the fight scenes are punchy and exciting. While the story is pretty simple, it keeps you on your toes without getting boring. If you love survival stories, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gore in detail, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes down to a desperate fight for survival in the station. You see the main character use his fighting skills to take out the remaining undead. In the final moments, he manages to break free and escape the building, but he realizes the entire city is overrun. He ends up alone in a wasteland, showing that while he survived the night, the world as he knew it is completely gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves zombie movies and survival thrillers.
